# Tooling and canonical documentation

This index combines live, read-only version probes for host tools with exact
versions from `package-lock.json`. Run `npm run docs:sync` on the canonical
working host after an intentional toolchain change, then review the diff.

Some upstream projects maintain one continuously updated manual rather than a
manual for every patch release. In those cases, the table pairs the exact local
version with the canonical current manual and identifies a local command for
the installed command surface.

Codex documentation is maintained as current product documentation rather than
as a separate manual for every CLI patch. Use the recorded Codex CLI version
and `codex --help` for the installed command surface, then consult the
official documentation and changelog for supported current behavior.

## APIs, MCP, and frameworks

- **Node.js APIs:** The application uses the standard library, including the
  [Node.js test runner](https://nodejs.org/download/release/v24.15.0/docs/api/test.html)
  and the version-matched [`node:sqlite` API](https://nodejs.org/download/release/v24.15.0/docs/api/sqlite.html).
- **Model Context Protocol:** The project config declares only OpenAI's public,
  read-only documentation server. See [OpenAI Docs MCP](https://developers.openai.com/learn/docs-mcp),
  [MCP in Codex](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/extend/mcp), and the
  [MCP specification](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/).
- **Application APIs:** M-05 uses only the version-matched
  [Node.js HTTP API](https://nodejs.org/download/release/v24.15.0/docs/api/http.html)
  on explicit loopback addresses. M-07A uses the version-matched
  [Node.js `fetch` API](https://nodejs.org/download/release/v24.15.0/docs/api/globals.html#fetch)
  for bounded same-origin synthetic reads. M-08 uses only the official
  [Classroom `courses.courseWork.list` API](https://developers.google.com/workspace/classroom/reference/rest/v1/courses.courseWork/list)
  through exact `@googleapis/classroom` 14.0.0. M-13 adds only
  the [Calendar `events.list` API](https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/events/list)
  through exact `@googleapis/calendar` 16.0.0. M-14 offline preparation also
  type-checks an injected, credential-free subset of `events.get`,
  `events.insert`, `events.update`, and `events.delete`; no official client is
  constructed and no Calendar API call or writer grant is authorized.
- **Application frameworks:** None are currently declared; this is a direct
  Node.js/TypeScript application.
- **Browser tooling:** Google Chrome is used for local visual verification and
  the M-07A synthetic dynamic-page/profile spike. The M-07A adapter accesses the
  separately installed browser through exact `playwright-core`; the package
  does not download a browser.

## Source of truth

1. `package-lock.json` governs exact JavaScript package versions.
2. `package.json` governs supported runtime ranges and npm commands.
3. Live `--version` output governs the canonical host's installed tools.
4. `.codex/environment.md` governs the expected project working context.
5. Upstream canonical documentation governs public tool and API contracts;
   installed help wins when a version-specific command surface differs.
